title: Bolt Seeks Up to $27M in Pay-to-Play Bridge Financing
dek: Bolt founder Ryan Breslow is contributing $5 million as the checkout company pursues a bridge round of up to $27 million, according to TechCrunch.
socialCaption: Bolt is seeking up to $27M in pay-to-play bridge funding, with founder Ryan Breslow contributing $5M. The structure highlights how companies can extend runway while reshaping investor incentives when a conventional round is difficult.
